name: Maintenance-mode closing inhibit
summary: Suppresses the defined automatic closing paths while the assigned maintenance mode is selected.
description: Suppresses the defined automatic closing paths while the assigned maintenance mode is selected. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Maintenance mode selection” at the input and “Automatic close inhibit” at the output. Maintenance mode does not create electrical isolation.
